name: LLM / Agent Action Surface (conditional — when system includes LLM agent)

checks.check: Action descriptions accurately describe handler behavior (description = contract surface for LLM router)
Tool parameter schemas (name, type, enum) match handler parsing
System prompt does not claim capabilities the system doesn't have
Available capabilities are discoverable through the effective system instructions and tool/skill definitions; do not require duplicating every tool name in prose.
Tool descriptions clearly distinguish examples/placeholders from real observations so the model does not report example values as live data.
Representative natural language inputs map to correct tool selection
Agent correctly refuses unsupported requests (no hallucinated actions)
Action surface exposure/pruning rules respected (no actions exposed that should be hidden)
Approval/side-effect boundaries enforce the granted action, target, scope and current revision before execution; ambiguous prior dispatch is reconciled before retry.
Tests cover: tool description accuracy, parameter schema consistency, routing correctness

For LLM/agent execution paths, ask the applicable runtime coverage questions: request/response (arrival, failure, latency), background (start, duplication, step), stateful (actual truth owner and evidence), external (provider or local failure).
Tool parameter schemas match handler parsing (name, type, enum).

checks.check: Tool output, retrieved documents, repository text and quoted examples remain untrusted data: they must not redefine the user’s task, grant permission, reveal credentials or trigger unrelated actions. Test both useful quoted content and an instruction-injection attempt at the actual execution boundary.
checks.why_not_a_checker: Whether natural-language source content is being promoted to authority requires contextual review and runtime behavior; matching a suspicious phrase alone is insufficient.

anti_patterns: Tool descriptions treated as code comments (not tested or maintained)
System prompt lists capabilities that don't exist
Only English input tested when users speak other languages
Tool registry changed but the effective capability descriptions/discovery remain incorrect
Agent suggests actions that aren't available
why: Review guidance, not an enforced checker or proof of review completion. Apply each question to this repo’s actual scope and architecture; state when it does not apply.
